body.value: IRE GUARANTEES.
* X
On tires we will give our customers the same protection accorded us by tire manu-
facturers.
Defective tires should be returned direct to the tire manufacturers and not
to us.
The manufacturers of tires have ample facilities for repairing same and do so
under their guarantee free of charge. Always prepay express charges.
THE FOLLOWING ARE COPIES OF GUARANTEES GIVEN BY TIRE MANUFACTURERS.
MORGAN & WRIGHT TIRES.
We shall continue in 1896 our custom of repairing all tires of our manufacture free of charge.
We shall replace defective parts when, in our judgment, the defect is from our fault. In no case will we replace when worn
out in service or injured by accident. Make your request direct to us, and not through the makers of your wheel.
Express charges on tires must be prepaid in every instance. If return by mail is desired, postage at the rate of one cent per
ounce must come with the request for repairs. Do not send the wheel with the tire.
See that every package sent has your address securely fastened to the package.
MORGAN & WRIGHT, 331 to 339 Lake Street, Chicago, Ills.
VIM TIRES.
We guarantee all our tires to be of perfect manufacture. We guarantee to repair all 1896 Vim tires free at any of our
repair departments during the season, but express charges must be prepaid. Tires sent by mail are at the owner's risk,
and postage at one cent per ounce must be sent for return mailing. To save time send the tire direct to our nearest repair
department, not to the bicycle manufacturer. See that your address is properly attached to the bundle.
We do not
receive tires from express companies unless the name of the sender is on them. Write us a letter under separate cover
stating how the tire is sent.
BOSTON WOVEN HOSE AND RUBBER Co., 275 Devonshire Street, Boston.
63 Reade Street, New York.
205 Lake Street, Chicago.
10 South Water Street, Cleveland.
14 Fremont Street, San Francisco.
PALMER TIRES.
We guarantee the Palmer tires against defects in material and workmanship, and will repair, free of charge, every
tire that can be repaired, no matter how the injury may have been caused, if delivered at 65 Reade Street, New York City.
or 133 South Clinton Street, Chicago, transportation charges prepaid.
We will replace all tires that cannot be repaired, if
on examination we find material or workmanship defective.
We will not replace or credit tires that have become un-
serviceable from any cause for which we are not responsible.
PALMER PNEUMATIC TIRE CO.,
NEW YORK TIRES.
We guarantee all our tires to be free from all imperfections in material and manufacture, and agree to make good
within the calendar year any tires returned to us, charges prepaid, that are defective.
We will repair free of charge all
punctures or other damage caused by accident to our tires, if delivered to us at 63 Franklin Street, Boston, 59 Reade Street,
New York, 334 Dearborn Street, Chicago, or 1510 Market Street, San Francisco.
NEW YORK TIRE CO.
NORTH AMERICAN TIRES.
All our single tube tires are guaranteed to be free from imperfections in material and workmanship, and when defect-
ive will be replaced free of charge, if delivered prepaid at factory of the North American Rubber Co., Setauket, N. Y.,
or 81 Reade Street, New York City, or 146 Kinzie Street, Chicago.
PARKHURST & WILKINSON.
GOODRICH TIRES.
These tires are guaranteed against defective workmanship and material to December 31, 1896. All tires will be repaired
free of charge, if delivered at our factory, prepaid, in Chicago, 159 Lake Street.
THE COLUMBIA RUBBER WORKS Co.
